AVIATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Components.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Components.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Components.
